purpose: Determine whether the chronology-safe NSE shareholding/XBRL archive can reconstruct five-quarter histories for the already-locked MF holding, institutional-FPI holding and institutional-breadth Smart Money components at a cohort size sufficient for a later outcome-blind holdout.
sample_rule: SHA256 outcome-blind deterministic NSE EQ company sample at the anchor
period_selection_rule: For each distinct period use the latest filing version whose known-at date is on or before the anchor; then use the latest five distinct safe periods. No post-anchor revision is permitted.

component_completeness.mf_holding_change_pp_4q: Locked member/fact mapping must be present and unambiguous in all five selected periods.
component_completeness.fii_holding_change_pp_4q: Locked institutional-FPI member/fact mapping must be present and unambiguous in all five selected periods.
component_completeness.institutional_breadth_change_4q: Locked InstitutionsMember/NumberOfShareholders mapping must be present and unambiguous in all five selected periods.

future_holdout_eligibility_diagnostic.note: This feasibility probe does not itself authorize a two-of-three score. Any later partial-score eligibility rule must be preregistered before outcomes.

prohibited_output: raw XBRL or raw shareholding rows
decision_rule: Proceed to a separately preregistered July-2022 Smart Money partial holdout only if at least 30 sampled companies have all three locked five-period component mappings complete. If all-three is below 30, stop before outcome load rather than weaken the five-period or semantic rules.
